tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Existence of weak solution] ↗ thm:monotonicity-approximate-solutions ↗ thm:monotonicity-energy-estimates ↗ def:monotone-vector-field 1. ch9:9.1-thm-3\group Nonlinear Elliptic PDE

There exists a weak solution of the nonlinear boundary-value problem (1).

Proof

\sketch The energy estimate gives $u_m\rightharpoonup u$ in $H_0^1$ and, by (4), $\mathbf a(Du_m)\rightharpoonup \xi $ in $L^2$. Passing to the Galerkin identities gives the weak equation with $\xi $. Minty’s monotonicity inequality, tested with $w=u-\lambda v$ and followed by $\lambda \downarrow 0$, identifies $\xi =\mathbf a(Du)$ weakly and yields (12).

□
